Training settings

Source: R/config.R
dragon_train_args.Rd

Training settings

Usage

dragon_train_args(
  epochs = 3,
  learning_rate = 2e-04,
  batch_size = 4,
  grad_accum = 4,
  max_seq_len = 1024,
  max_steps = NULL,
  warmup_ratio = 0.03,
  weight_decay = 0,
  logging_steps = 5,
  save_steps = 100,
  gradient_checkpointing = FALSE,
  eval_batch_size = 1,
  seed = 42,
  ...
)

Arguments

epochs

Passes over the training data. Ignored when max_steps is set.

learning_rate

Peak learning rate. 2e-4 is a good LoRA default.

batch_size

Examples per device per step.

grad_accum

Steps to accumulate before an optimizer update. Effective batch size is batch_size * grad_accum.

max_seq_len

Maximum tokens per example. Longer examples are truncated.

max_steps

Stop after this many optimizer steps. NULL trains for epochs.

warmup_ratio

Fraction of steps used to warm up the learning rate.

weight_decay

Weight decay for the optimizer.

logging_steps

Steps between progress rows.

save_steps

Steps between checkpoints.

gradient_checkpointing

Trade compute for memory. Turn on if you run out of GPU memory.

eval_batch_size

Held-out rows scored per forward pass, during training and at the end. Defaults to 1: scoring materializes a batch x tokens x vocabulary tensor, so at long max_seq_len a larger value can run a GPU out of memory after training has already succeeded. Raise it for speed on a large GPU.

seed

Random seed.

...

Extra named arguments passed straight to TrainingArguments.

Value

A dragon_train_args object.

Examples

dragon_train_args(epochs = 1, learning_rate = 1e-4)
